name: io.github.sapientsai/temporal-mcp-server
description: Time, timezone and duration tools — IANA zones, conversion, DST-correct date arithmetic.

tools.name: info
tools.description: Returns identity and build information for this server (name, version, build commit, runtime, capability counts)

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Return the current time as an epoch, a UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, and the wall-clock time in a given timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

tools.name: convert_timezone
tools.description: Render an ISO-8601 timestamp as wall-clock time in a target timezone.

sourceTimezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret `isoTimestamp` when it carries no 'Z' or offset. Ignored otherwise. Defaults to UTC.

targetTimezone.description: IANA timezone identifier to render in.

tools.name: add_duration
tools.description: Add an ISO-8601 duration to a timestamp, in a timezone. Date units (Y/M/D) are calendar-aware: P1D across a DST boundary keeps the same wall-clock time the next day, and P1M on Jan 31 clamps to the end of February. Time units (H/M/S) are exact elapsed time, so PT24H really is 24 hours. Prefix the duration with '-' to subtract.

timezone.description: IANA timezone governing the arithmetic — calendar units are applied to this zone's wall clock, and a timestamp with no 'Z' or offset is read as wall-clock time here. Defaults to UTC.

tools.name: time_between
tools.description: Exact elapsed time between two ISO-8601 timestamps, broken into days/hours/minutes/seconds plus a human-readable summary. All components share one sign, so they sum correctly; `direction` is 'past', 'future', or 'same'.

from.description: Start of the interval, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret timestamps that carry no 'Z' or offset. Defaults to UTC.

to.description: End of the interval, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.
